research_question: Which packet-causal components contribute to CSPP event-record detection and quiet-background rejection under one fixed training recipe and one detached verifier recipe?

evidence_boundary.geonet_2026_role: post-hoc paired diagnostic only; no model, epoch, threshold, or arm selection is permitted
evidence_boundary.independent_cross_network_role: permitted only if its metadata-only cohort and endpoint protocol are frozen before any waveform or model output is opened
evidence_boundary.claim: Ablation estimates are component-dependence diagnostics. They are not a new model-selection exercise or a SOTA claim.

design.checkpoint_rule: Use fixed epoch 3 for every candidate and verifier. Development waveform inference and threshold scanning are disabled.
design.candidate_training: All five candidates within each seed use the same frozen record selection, ordering, optimizer settings, and all losses except the explicitly ablated term. The three seeds independently vary initialization and training order.
design.verifier_training: Each candidate receives a newly initialized verifier with compressed candidate-connected evidence only. Candidate, timing, and dense-phase branches are frozen during verifier training.

arms.change: Replace the two-layer unidirectional GRU and previous-packet difference by a current-packet projection with zero stream state.
Remove dense within-packet P peak and mass from the candidate head while retaining dense localization supervision through the shared packet encoder.
Retain dense within-packet P evidence in the candidate head while setting its explicit localization-loss weight to zero.
Replace all fixed current-packet spectral descriptors by zeros while retaining the packet morphology encoder.

design.paired_seed_analysis: Report each seed and paired arm deltas; aggregate the three complete candidate-plus-verifier pipelines without selecting a favorable seed.

evaluation_contract.paired_reporting: Report every arm; do not select the best ablation seed or retune an arm-specific threshold.
